# Sentence breaking tests
#
# Format: input is the concatenation of the segments, which are separated by '|'.
# Everything after a '#' and blank lines are ignored.
# Characters can be escaped as \u{XXXX}.

# https://github.com/unicode-org/icu4x/issues/3885
. |🤥 # [ATerm] [Sp] [Any]
. \u{A}|🤥 # [ATerm] [Sp] [ParaSep] [Any]
." |🤥 # [ATerm] [Close] [Sp] [Any]
." \u{A}|🤥 # [ATerm] [Close] [Sp] [ParaSep] [Any]
." |" # [ATerm] [Close] [Sp] [Close]
." |1 # [ATerm] [Close] [Sp] [Numeric]
." |A # [ATerm] [Close] [Sp] [Upper]
." |ぁ # [ATerm] [Close] [Sp] [OLetter]
! |🤥 # [STerm] [Sp] [Any]
! \u{A}|🤥 # [STerm] [Sp] [ParaSep] [Any]
!" \u{A}|🤥 # [STerm] [Close] [Sp] [ParaSep] [Any]
!" |" # [STerm] [Close] [Sp] [Close]
!" |1 # [STerm] [Close] [Sp] [Numeric]
!" |A # [STerm] [Close] [Sp] [Upper]
!" |ぁ # [STerm] [Close] [Sp] [OLetter]
